Unmodified official prebuilt DLL, including its embedded kernel drivers.
Upstream: https://vps.highrez.co.uk/downloads/InpOut32/default.htm
DLL source: https://www.highrez.co.uk/scripts/download.asp?package=Inpout32_dll_source
Driver source links are on the upstream page.
Loaded only when native AdLib is explicitly selected. Loading may install/start
its embedded driver; initial installation requires Administrator privileges on
the destination computer. No separate InstallDriver.exe or SYS file is needed.
